title: helenium borchersii
intro: Helenium borchersii, commonly known as Borchers' Sneezeweed or Borchers' False Sneezeweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, including its reported anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which provide relief from fever, colds, and respiratory infections, and it is also used to treat sore throats and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Helenium borchersii include its ability to stimulate sweating, reduce fever, and act as a diaphoretic agent. The bioactive constituents of Helenium borchersii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
